children: ) announced today that it will hold its fiscal first quarter earnings conference call on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time.
A live webcast and a webcast replay of the conference call will be available at investor.sandisk.com.

Built on more than three decades of innovation, Sandisk is a vertically integrated global semiconductor company dedicated to delivering memory technologies that help people and businesses unlock the potential of their data. From the enterprise SSDs powering AI infrastructure to consumer devices and connected systems at the edge, Sandisk designs and manufactures memory solutions that fuel the modern digital economy. To learn more, visit www.sandisk.com.
